in_hebrew.name: Aline
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Aline הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Latin word 'alere' meaning 'to nourish'. Aline is a name of noble origin, symbolizing kindness and nourishment towards others.

in_greek.long_meaning: Aline είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Latin word 'alere' meaning 'to nourish'. Aline is a name of noble origin, symbolizing kindness and nourishment towards others.

in_latin.name: Aline
in_latin.meaning: Originating from Germanic tribes, Aline signifies nobility and aristocracy.
in_latin.long_meaning: Aline, derived from the Germanic word 'adal' meaning nobility, and 'line' signifying aristocracy or lineage, has its roots in ancient European cultures. In the context of Christian tradition, Aline symbolizes spiritual nobility and a high standing in the Kingdom of Heaven.
